Question Choices: Select the number of solutions for this system where Plan A is $y = 10x + 50$ and Plan B is $y = 5x + 100$: ~~One | None | Infinite~~
Hints: Use equivalent line equations: identical lines, distinct parallel lines, or one intersection.
Solution: The line equations have different slopes, so they meet once. System: y=10 × x+50; y=5 × x+100. Isolate y: y=(10)x+(50). Substitute into the other equation: (-5)x+(1)[(10)x+(50)]=100. Combine: (5)x=50, so x=10. Then y=(10)(10)+(50)=150. Check both equations: -10(10)+1(150)=50; -5(10)+1(150)=100. Requested answer: One.
